description: This is a JavaScript source file that defines Dutch (Netherlands) culture information for the DateJS library, including date formats, day and month names, regex patterns for parsing dates, and prototype extensions for date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time components of a Date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current Date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.description: Returns the index of a day given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of a month given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month and year.
